stock_contract: Ghidra decompilation, P-Code and Assembly entry 0012860c
limitations: The candidate remains an IDA/Ghidra-style decompiler export with raw offsets and compatibility aliases; it is not yet a canonical typed GKI C implementation.

The harness proves null handling, parser disablement, format termination, selected scalar fields and invalid widths through a compatibility layer; it does not prove every custom-format opcode or callback path.
The Assembly emission covers the ABI probe wrapper, not a relocation-equivalent build of the full raw candidate.
Canonical module build, typed layout review, KCFI/relocation comparison, independent review and physical hardware validation remain required.
